Documentation.TagDescription: Warehouse reference data backed by a local SQLite database. No external dependencies required.

MethodDocumentation.GET: Version 2 returns camelCase field names, matching the proxy endpoints. Supports `$filter`, `$select`, `$orderby`, `$top`, `$skip` on the same names.
MethodDocumentation.QUERY: Same query as `GET` with the OData options in a JSON request body, e.g. `{"filter": "country eq 'NL'", "top": 5}`.
